document_revisions_verdict_recorded.name: document_revisions_verdict_recorded
document_revisions_verdict_recorded.value: "document_revisions"."scan_state" = 'pending' OR ("document_revisions"."scanned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "document_revisions"."scanner" IS NOT NULL)

documents_archive_consistent.name: documents_archive_consistent
documents_archive_consistent.value: ("documents"."archived_at" IS NULL) = ("documents"."archived_by" IS NULL) AND ("documents"."archived_at" IS NULL) = ("documents"."archive_reason" IS NULL)

follow_ups_completed_consistent.name: follow_ups_completed_consistent
follow_ups_completed_consistent.value: ("follow_ups"."state" = 'completed') = ("follow_ups"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "follow_ups"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)

follow_ups_cancelled_consistent.name: follow_ups_cancelled_consistent
follow_ups_cancelled_consistent.value: ("follow_ups"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("follow_ups"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "follow_ups"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "follow_ups"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

opportunities_awarded_requires_outcome.name: opportunities_awarded_requires_outcome
opportunities_awarded_requires_outcome.value: "opportunities"."stage" <> 'awarded' OR ("opportunities"."awarded_value" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."awarded_value" > 0 AND "opportunities"."award_date" IS NOT NULL)

opportunities_lost_requires_outcome.name: opportunities_lost_requires_outcome
opportunities_lost_requires_outcome.value: "opportunities"."stage" <> 'lost' OR ("opportunities"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."closed_date" IS NOT NULL)

opportunities_loss_other_explained.name: opportunities_loss_other_explained
opportunities_loss_other_explained.value: "opportunities"."loss_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR "opportunities"."loss_note" IS NOT NULL

opportunities_award_only_when_awarded.name: opportunities_award_only_when_awarded
opportunities_award_only_when_awarded.value: "opportunities"."stage" = 'awarded' OR ("opportunities"."awarded_value" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."award_date" IS NULL)

opportunities_loss_only_when_lost.name: opportunities_loss_only_when_lost
opportunities_loss_only_when_lost.value: "opportunities"."stage" = 'lost' OR ("opportunities"."loss_reason" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."loss_note" IS NULL)

tenders_late_submission_explained.name: tenders_late_submission_explained
tenders_late_submission_explained.value: "tenders"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR "tenders"."submitted_at" <= "tenders"."submission_deadline" OR "tenders"."late_submission_note" IS NOT NULL
